issues.where: nearest long-legged animal just right of the left foreground rocks, across the six-second hold
issues.what: the head and neck dip and return while the feet and torso stay almost in the same pose, making it read like a parked model with a hinged neck
issues.fix: shift weight through the shoulders and hips before the dip, give one foot a planted adjustment, and vary pauses and head turns across the herd

issues.where: bright cascade beneath the overhang and its fan at the foot of the slope
issues.what: the bright flecks change but the branching sheet and fan hold nearly the same shape, so the movement reads more as shimmer than as molten rock coming down the slope
issues.fix: move coherent lobes down the steps, roll darker crust over them, and let the lobes deform and spread at the foot

issues.where: low orange fume over the vent on the right of the field
issues.what: the fume swells and fades around the same pocket without a clear trail of heavier vapor gathering or flowing away along the ground
issues.fix: advect irregular puffs across the crust and let them collect in low areas instead of mostly brightening and fading at the vent
